title: The Radiators of the old quarter
author: O. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Cyrus Sandoval, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
